name: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces (S4)
problem: RNNs, CNNs and Transformers all have variants for long dependencies but struggle to scale to sequences of 10,000 steps or more, and no single model handled sequence data across modalities and tasks.
mechanism: Resurrects the structured state space model x'(t) = A x(t) + B u(t), y(t) = C x(t) + D u(t), realised as a CNN layer, and shows that when the state matrix A is HiPPO-structured the resulting kernel is computed in O(L log L) with FFTs instead of O(L^2) with attention. The HiPPO construction makes A = -1/2 * B C^T - i sqrt(B C^T) for a well-chosen (B, C), producing the 'S4D' real variant and 'S4' complex variant. Crucially the parameters here are FIXED (not a function of the input), which is precisely the weakness Mamba later identifies and fixes. State is fixed-size and constant in sequence length, so like all SSMs there is no KV cache; this was demonstrated at long context before selective SSMs existed.
speedup_reported: The paper's headline is that a single architecture with a single set of parameters matches or exceeds specialist models across long-range sequence benchmarks (LRA, Long Range Arena) including sequential CIFAR, Path-x, Path-256, and it reaches near state of the art on audio classification and LM tasks while being substantially faster than attention at long length. Numbers are relative perplexities and accuracy, not tokens/second, so there is no clean speedup ratio to quote; the FFT-based O(L log L) formulation is the structural efficiency claim.
notes: Venue is JMLR 2022, confirmed via Semantic Scholar, but the paper schema's venue enum has no JMLR entry so this is recorded as 'other'; the authoritative venue is in notes.  Title on arXiv has no 'S4' in it, so search by 'S4' alone will return many unrelated papers. Fixed-parameter (non-selective) recurrence: this is why Mamba-1 supersedes it, and why no 2024-2026 production model is a pure S4. Historical importance only; the serving-side lesson it established (constant state, no KV cache) is carried forward by every Mamba descendant. Not present in llama.cpp's arch registry and not a row in vLLM's native list.
